q: Austria's vineyard classification is being written privately before it is written into law. Which association classifies Erste Lage sites in the Danube regions, and which classifies Erste STK Ried and Grosse STK Ried in Styria?
accept: otw osterreichische traditionsweinguter and stk steirische terroir und klassikweinguter
otw for the danube, stk for styria
osterreichische traditionsweinguter and the styrian stk growers
otw erste lage and stk steirische terroir klassikweinguter
ans: The ÖTW (Österreichische Traditionsweingüter) along the Danube, and the STK (Steirische Terroir- und Klassikweingüter) in Steiermark
exp: Both are private growers' associations on the VDP model, not INAO-style law: ÖTW began classifying Erste Lage sites in Kamptal and Kremstal in 2010 and spread to Traisental, Wagram, Carnuntum and Wien, marking approved sites with its 1ÖTW logo; STK runs a pyramid rising to Grosse STK Ried. The state's own contribution is the Riedenwein tier, which protects the site name but ranks nothing — the takeaway is that in Austria the hierarchy of sites is association work, and the law only guarantees that the name on the bottle is a real vineyard.
